## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -2.44%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.30%) show downside pressure while VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising flags a mixed fear signal.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit and rates flat-to-tight: HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.13%) → flat and LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -1.32%) ↓ falling. Fear mixed: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising short-term.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Bonds under pressure: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.24%) ↓ falling; combined with weak credit and narrow equity breadth this implies slightly tighter financial conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.49%) ↑ rising. Tech lagging and cyclicals weak: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.30%) ↓ falling and Financials broadly weak (sector: 1W: -0.70% | 1M: -3.55%); Style: mixed / no clear leadership given 2/11 breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US underperforming on trend: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -2.44%). Emerging markets and China also weak: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -1.28%) ↓ falling and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -1.40%) ↓ falling.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative assets showing pullbacks within larger gains: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -2.88% | 1M: +20.99%) and ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -3.01% | 1M: +2.95%) while small caps IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -6.29%) indicate waning risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity bifurcation: oil ETFs leading — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +25.51%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.84% | 1M: +27.85%) ↑ rising — while base metals and precious metals are soft: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -4.68% | 1M: -3.35%), GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -1.83%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy complex strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.49%) ↑ rising and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +6.25%) → flat; energy is the clearest sector driver.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership via XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.49%) and bond weakness TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.24%) support a risk-tilt inconsistency. DIVERGENCE: multiple crypto/thematic ETFs in CORRECTION (ETHA 1W: -2.78% | 1M: +28.35%; IBIT 1W: -2.88% | 1M: +20.99%; ARKK 1W: -3.01% | 1M: +2.95%) represent a MINOR divergence versus the narrow market.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy themes (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.49%)); reduce exposure to technology (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.30%)) and small caps (IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -6.29%)); monitor credit HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.13%) → flat and VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising for regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.49%); Commodities/Oil — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +25.51%). BEARISH: Technology — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.30%); Industrials — XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -9.47%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/WTI — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +25.51%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.84% | 1M: +27.85%). BEARISH: Copper — CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -4.68% | 1M: -3.35%); Gold — GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -1.83%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -5.66%) RECOVERY — watch ~20 for complacency shifts; HYG (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -1.32%) BELOW TREND — watch HYG/LQD for credit stress; XLK (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND vs XLE (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.49%) ABOVE TREND — watch the growth→energy leadership spread.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.49%)) showing relative strength while Technology (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.30%)) and small caps (IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -6.29%)) show weakness. Key risk is the narrow market and thematic/crypto pullbacks — monitor VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -5.66%) ↑ rising and HYG/LQD for any regime shift.
